address: Largo Gelso 16, Polignano a Mare, 70044, Italy
bio: A few metres from Modugno’s statue and a breathtaking sea-facing balcony, with picturesque houses perched above Polignano, you’ll find exceptional cuisine, the creation of Andrea Vicario, whose hands craft predominantly seafood dishes with high effect and quality, showcasing a great passion—amongst mains—for charcoal cooking.
